name: Gabrielle Stone
source:
Gabrielle "Gabby" Stone, [url=/c176650]John[/url]'s best friend Mike's younger sister. John has known her for as long as he can remember. What is harder to remember was when she changed from being an annoying little ankle biter into a smoke show. Gabby is studying law at Rackham University, but seems to spend most of her time helping Mike at the office. She is sweet, caring, and intelligent.

[Edited from in-game description]
